description: One neighbourhood in detail for a decision: local market (sales, turnover, leasehold share, £/m² medians, growth), the local authority's official UK HPI (hpi: average price by type, 1/5/10-year change vs its region: quote this for how prices moved), £/m² price trend, crime with its offence mix (topTypes, a busy-centre note), road/rail noise, nearby state schools with their standing Ofsted grade plus independent schools (schools.independent), planning rules (home: conservation, Article 4, listed buildings, broadband), when its homes were built (buildAge), householder planning (planning: home works, the share refused, approval by kind of works in London, the Renovation score), council tax bands and a typical bill (councilTax), the IMD decile (deprivation), typicalPrice (the median sale of the last 12 months, the figure every tool quotes; property_type gives that type's figure, as find_areas prices it), a flood line, a ballpark price for a bedroom count (buy only), the rent first with market='rent', and website links; detail='full' adds every month, school, HPI type and attribution. Comparisons are with the area's region (regionChange, regionPercentile: London's areas among London's); londonChange and londonPercentile are deprecated aliases holding the same values.

bad.description: What was wrong, missing or confusing.
bad.title: Bad

call_id.description: The callId of the answer you are rating; leave it out when answers carry none.
call_id.title: Call Id

fix.description: The change to the tool or its answer you would want.
fix.title: Fix

good.description: What was useful in the answer.
good.title: Good

rating.description: 1 = useless or wrong, 3 = usable with gaps, 5 = exactly what was needed.
rating.title: Rating

bedrooms.description: Adds a ballpark price for this size.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

detail.description: summary = priceTrend as the last 24 quarterly points; full = every monthly point.
detail.title: Detail

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

market.description: rent = the rent block leads the answer.
market.title: Market

property_type.description: typicalPrice for this home type, the figure find_areas and assess_listing quote for it (priceBasis says which); all types when omitted.
property_type.title: Property Type

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried (none: the last answer). Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.
